On the left to supporters of Trump, sure. But as I‘m sure you know, that is not what I meant. When I am or anyone else is talking about „left“ or „right“, they‘re talking about, where these political ideas are located on the spectrum relative to the center.

When I‘m saying „noone on the left is pro-Obama“, what I mean is, that noone on the left supports US imperialism and the bombing of innocent people in the middle east, yada yada. That is not to say however, that I dislike his progressive domestic policies, like the ACA.
But when you look at the man‘s entire political record, it becomes obvious that overall he has increased the power of the wealthy, neoliberal elite, increasing income disparity and social injustice in the US and the world.

Of course, unfortunately, „The Left“ is a spectrum in and of itself. The divided left, which paralyzes itself. So people who identify as left-wing, but aren‘t very educated on sociology and politics, might think that Obama is a great guy and support him.
If you take this thought further, that the more educated you are on these topics, the more left you are, you could say that even political moderates or centrists are „left-wing“. Because they cannot grasp their own wrongdoing.

It‘s just that your sentence implied a dichotomy between „you“ and „the mushroom“, which lead me to believe that „you“ is supposed to be the reader.

What I am trying to say is, the person taking the mushrooms is their own teacher. We all have it in us to reach enlightenment, but substances like lysergic acid or psilocybin make it substantially easier.

But since >67% of all schizophrenics have no prior history of it in their family, you can‘t know if you‘re predisposed until you „get it“.
In my case, too much use of cannabis, ketamine, cocaine or amphetamine-like drugs leads to schizo-disorder type symtoms. And since schizophrenia isn‘t uniquely identifiable like a physical disease, but consists much rather of an accumulation of symptoms, you could say that I was a 30% schizophrenic. Schizophrenia is in that regard more akin to a spectrum (though it is not necessarily a spectrum!), than a binary.

I haven’t found LSD, mushrooms or 2-CB to have this effect on me, by the way.

Psychosis is the name we give positive symptoms of schizo-type disorders. Yes, schizophrenia also consists of negative symptoms but you can see that psychosis is definitely a huge part of disorders like bipolar or schizophrenia.
